text:
Mira: Quick thread — drafting internal release notes and deploy plan for tonight's cutover. Putting copy + rollback steps in one place.
Ben: Thanks. Can you paste the short TL;DR we send to SRE and sales?
Mira: TL;DR: minor perf improvements to runtime batching, reduced tail latency ~15%, opt-in quantized variant for large-context clients, no API changes. :rocket: 
Jenna: Add note about EU model pinning and data residency.
Mira: Good call. Adding: 'EU customers will route to model v2.1-eu (pinned) for the first 48 hours.'
Tom: On rollback — what's the safe fallback? Full model rollback or routing fallback?
Mira: Two-step rollback: 1) switch routing to v2.0 (fast) 2) if issues persist, revert canary and redeploy runtime image. I'll paste commands.
Mira: ```
# switch routing to stable
redwood route update --service inference --from v2.1 --to v2.0 --region eu-west-1
# revert canary
redwood deploy cancel --id canary-2026-03-22
``` 
Ben: perfect. add estimate for customer impact window and postmortem owner.
Mira: Impact window: expected <5 mins for routing flip, monitor for 30m after. Postmortem owner: @Ava.
Ava: got it, I'll stand by tonight. Please add SLO alert thresholds.
Mira: SLOs: p95 latency threshold 600ms, error rate >0.5% triggers immediate rollback.
Jenna: Can we schedule deploybot quiet window so nobody triggers unrelated deploys during canary?
Mira: yes — deploybot scheduled at 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z with quiet window 02:00–03:30 UTC. deploying 5% canary -> 25% -> 100% if green.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued by @Mira: release/v2.1
deploy-bot: Canary steps: 5% for 15m -> 25% for 20m -> 100%.
Tom: add a short blurb for internal release note (one paragraph) we can paste into #general and sales.
Mira: draft: "Tonight we rollout performance and quantization updates to the inference runtime improving tail latency and offering an opt-in quantized model for large-context users. EU customers will see a pinned model variant for data residency. No API changes."
Ben: LGTM. Change window reminder to org: ETA 02:00 UTC, expect brief routing swap. :bell:
Jenna: Legal/Privacy ok with the EU pinning? we got LUK signoff yesterday.
Mira: yes LUK approved, added to thread earlier.
Ava: I'll own post-deploy smoke tests and the incident channel if needed. Oncall is @Tom.
Tom: I'll be oncall for first 2 hours.
Mira: OK locking copy and commands. I'll post final internal note 30m before deploy. :thumbsup: 
Ben: thanks — please add the link to the deploy dashboard in the final note.
Mira: will do. dashboard: https://dash.internal.redwood/release/2026-03-22/v2.1
deploy-bot: Scheduled: 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z — reminder at -30m.
Mira: done, closing prep thread. ping if anything else tonight.
